summary: Capability, model authority and provider authority are separate decisions that must agree before dispatch.

items.text: After measuring whether a model can perform the task, consult the trust map to decide whether that model may perform it in the current context.
Verify that the selected execution provider is approved for the task's data, tools and side effects; model fitness alone does not approve the channel.
See Escalation Cascade for the related use case or counterpoint: Start with the smallest model that may succeed; pay for a larger one only when evidence says it will not.
See Not framing the agent as a pro for the related use case or counterpoint: Treating the agent like a generic chatbot — no role, no standards — invites confident hallucination.
See Agent-Workforce Management for the related use case or counterpoint: Manage agents like a workforce — roles, costs, allowances, escalation paths.
Feed accepted, revised, rejected and later-regressed asynchronous results back from Fire, Track, Review so task-specific capability estimates improve with observed outcomes.
